rewrites.comment: SPA history fallback, narrowed to paths that cannot be files. A request for a missing asset (anything containing a dot) now falls through to Vercel's static handling and correctly returns 404, instead of receiving index.html with a 200 and a JavaScript content type. Source: https://vercel.com/docs/project-configuration

redirects.comment: One host, one canonical. Serving the same pages on two hostnames splits ranking signals, so the apex is the only one that answers 200.

headers.comment: Vite emits content-hashed filenames, so these can be cached forever. This is the single largest repeat-visit win available without changing the app.
Static brand and SEO assets change only when they are redeployed.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy would not reach anyone already holding a copy.
Security headers. Deliberately limited to ones that cannot affect application behaviour; see docs/SEO.md for the Content-Security-Policy that is recommended but still needs a payment smoke test.
